test_run_actor_critic_rnn: test the actor_critic_rnn agent by running it for 5 episodes across bsuite environments
run_experiment_with_agent: run an experiment using the default agent with a bsuite environment for a set number of episodes
load_bsuite_environment: load a bsuite environment from its ID string using bsuite.load_from_id

review_RunTest_class: review the RunTest class that parameterizes agent training tests across bsuite sweep environments
